title: Halting during rewind from a bounded position
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $r,t$ be natural numbers. Suppose every choice word of length exactly $t$, run on $N$ from its initial configuration on $x$, ends in a halted configuration. For every $i\in\mathbb N$ and $j$ with $0\le j\le r$ such that $j+i=r$, every counter $c$ with $0\le c\le r+1$, and every augmented configuration $C$ in rewind phase at $(j,c)$ with empty output and all later blocks blank with their heads at $0$, if the input-head position of $C$ is at most $t+1$, then every choice word of length exactly $i(2t+3)+1$ makes the amplified machine started from $C$ halt.
